description: This PHP class 'FormatWithSkill' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface for formatting entity values specifically related to 'Skill' entities. It retrieves a 'Skill' by its ID using 'SkillService' and returns the skill's name.

classes.name: FormatWithSkill
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting skill-related values by fetching skill names via 'SkillService'.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the skill entity by ID and returns its name if found, otherwise null.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Provides an instance of 'SkillService', creating it if necessary.
